evals.name: extract-and-translate-with-preservation
evals.prompt: In this HarmonyOS module, internationalize visible hardcoded strings in the .ets pages and components. The configured locales are zh_CN and en_US; base currently contains English fallback values. Add translations for missing keys, preserve all existing translations, replace UI literals with $r references, and validate placeholder parity. Do not touch non-UI strings or assets.
evals.expected_output: Only static UI copy is moved into resource files; source literals reference semantic app.string keys; missing locale values are translated; pre-existing values remain unchanged; placeholders are preserved; JSON and references validate.
expectations: All identified static visible UI strings have matching resource keys and source references.
Existing translations are unchanged and missing configured-locale translations are added.
Formatting placeholders are preserved consistently across locales.
All edited string.json files parse and all changed resource references resolve.

evals.name: exclude-non-ui-text-and-qualifier-folders
evals.prompt: Audit this .ets project for hardcoded UI copy and internationalize it. The project has base, zh_CN, en_US, and dark resource folders. Keep console logs, comments, URLs, API paths/field names, identifiers, user-provided values, and dynamic text unchanged. Do not treat dark as a language and do not alter or add icon assets.
evals.expected_output: Only confirmed static user-visible copy is extracted. Excluded strings and assets remain untouched. dark is treated as a visual qualifier, not a locale, and locale synchronization applies only to configured language directories.
expectations: Logs, comments, URLs, API paths/field names, identifiers, dynamic values, and user input are not moved to string resources.
The dark qualifier directory is not treated as a language locale.
No image or icon assets are created, copied, or modified.

evals.name: ask-before-assuming-base-or-target-language
evals.prompt: Please internationalize the hardcoded UI text in my HarmonyOS app. It has only resources/base/element/string.json, and the project does not document which language base represents. I did not specify any target locales. Prepare zh_CN and en_US resource files if needed.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks which target locales are required and what language/policy base follows, explains that base is not assumed to be Chinese or English, and makes no source/resource edits until clarified.
expectations: The agent asks for target locales and the base/source-language policy before editing.
No files are created or modified before the locale ambiguity is resolved.
The agent does not assume that base is zh_CN or en_US.

evals.name: create-missing-module-resource-tree
evals.prompt: This is a new HarmonyOS ArkTS module at entry/. It has entry/src/main/module.json5 and entry/src/main/ets/pages/WelcomePage.ets, but no resources directory yet. The visible strings in the page are English. Make English the base fallback and support zh_CN and en_US. Extract the visible UI copy, create the required resource directory/file structure, add translations, replace the literals with $r references, and validate the result. Do not create unrelated media/profile/rawfile directories.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies entry as the target module, creates entry/src/main/resources/base/element/string.json and locale element/string.json files for zh_CN and en_US, adds corresponding translations, updates only UI literals to resource references, and validates JSON, keys, and references.
expectations: The missing resources tree is created under entry/src/main/resources, not AppScope or another module.
base/element/string.json, zh_CN/element/string.json, and en_US/element/string.json exist and parse.
Only required resources/element paths are created; unrelated resource groups are not fabricated.
Every extracted static UI string has matching locale keys and a resolving $r reference.
